description: This file contains test cases for a FastAPI application that uses dependency injection, including counters, scope handling, and security dependencies. It defines the application routes, dependencies, and tests to verify the dependency behavior.

methods.name: dep_counter()
methods.description: Asynchronous dependency that increments and returns a shared counter.

methods.name: super_dep(count: int = Depends(dep_counter))
methods.description: Async dependency that depends on dep_counter and returns the count.

methods.name: get_counter(count: int = Depends(dep_counter))
methods.description: GET endpoint returning the current counter value.

methods.name: get_sub_counter( subcount: int = Depends(super_dep), count: int = Depends(dep_counter) )
methods.description: GET endpoint returning count and sub-count, depends on super_dep and dep_counter.

methods.name: get_sub_counter_no_cache( subcount: int = Depends(super_dep), count: int = Depends(dep_counter, use_cache=False), )
methods.description: GET endpoint similar to get_sub_counter but disables caching for dep_counter.

methods.name: get_scope_counter( count: int = Security(dep_counter), scope_count_1: int = Security(dep_counter, scopes=["scope"]), scope_count_2: int = Security(dep_counter, scopes=["scope"]), )
methods.description: GET endpoint that demonstrates security dependencies and scope handling with counters.

methods.name: test_normal_counter()
methods.description: Test case verifying normal counter increment behavior.

methods.name: test_sub_counter()
methods.description: Test case verifying sub-counter behavior with dependency chaining.

methods.name: test_sub_counter_no_cache()
methods.description: Test case verifying behavior when dependency cache is disabled.

methods.name: test_security_cache()
methods.description: Test case verifying counter behavior with security dependencies and scopes.
